status: adopted for the six-frame bounding run
prompt:
Create ONE NEW pixel-art run-cycle sprite sheet for a top-down 2D fantasy action game. Image 1 shows the character standing, from the front, the side and the back. Image 2 is the character's old run sheet: keep its character, proportions, palette, dark outline and pixel-art style. The character is a small chibi knight with a silver helmet, silver armour, a blue tunic with gold trim, a sword in the right hand and a blue shield with a white cross in the left hand.

Layout: exactly 3 rows and 6 columns on a completely flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Every character is the same size, about 230 pixels tall, centred in an evenly spaced grid cell. Keep clear magenta space between all characters, so that even the widest stride stays inside its own cell.

The six columns are one full running cycle of a powerful sprinter with two long bounding strides. The stride is much longer than in Image 2.

Column 1, contact A: the right foot has just landed far in front of the body, heel first. The left foot is far behind, still pushing off the ground with its toe. The legs are spread very wide. The body is at middle height.
Column 2, push A: the right foot is planted flat on the ground, a little behind the hips, the right knee bent and carrying the weight. The left knee swings forward past the right knee, the left foot lifted. The body is at its lowest.
Column 3, flight A: both feet are clearly off the ground. The right leg is stretched far behind after pushing off. The left knee is driven high in front. The body is at its highest, floating.
Column 4, contact B: the same pose as column 1 with the legs swapped: the left foot lands far in front, the right foot pushes off far behind.
Column 5, push B: the same pose as column 2 with the legs swapped.
Column 6, flight B: the same pose as column 3 with the legs swapped.

Row 1: running toward the viewer, front view. Show the stride with height and size: a foot near the viewer is low and large, a foot far behind is higher and partly hidden behind the body.
Row 2: running to the right, side view, leaning forward strongly, with the long stride clearly visible.
Row 3: running away from the viewer, back view. A foot near the viewer is low, a foot far ahead is higher and partly hidden behind the body.

The arms swing opposite to the legs, strongly, like a sprinter. The helmet, armour, shield and sword keep the same shape, size and colours in every frame. The sword stays in the right hand and the shield on the left arm.

Do not include: text, labels, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadows, dust, effects, borders, watermark, or any other object. No soft gradients, blur or painterly rendering.
